title: PRIVATE TOUR BANGKOK STANDARD
route: Mae Klong Railway Market - Damnoen Saduak Floating Market - Grand Palace - Chatuchak Market - Siam Paragon - Pratunam Market

includes: Airport Transfer from BKK or DMK
excludes: Private Driver & Guide is based on 12 hours basis; additional fees apply for every extra hour

itinerary.title: Bangkok & Maeklong
activities: Damnoen Saduak Floating Market (add-on long tail boat: RM280 per boat)

itinerary.title: Bangkok City
activities: The Grand Palace OR Wat Arun Temple
OR Kanchanaburi Safari Park Full Day Tour (Add On: RM160 per pax, 3 hours one way journey)
OR Safari World Bangkok Half Day Tour (Add On: RM150 per pax)
OR Pattaya Full Day Tour (Add: RM80 per pax, 2-3 hours one way journey)

expect.title: Personal Expense
expect.body: Items not stated in the itinerary are at customers' own expense. Eg: Giraffe Encounter, Sunflower field, Long Tail Boat.

expect.title: Prepare Cash
expect.body: Prepare cash if you plan to shop at Night market. Cards and QR are not available at some shops and street stalls.

expect.title: Driver & Transport
expect.body: Transport is on 12 hours basis. Extra hours will be charged 500THB/Hour.

expect.title: Lots of Walking
expect.body: Expect lots of walking during trips to Safari, Shopping at Night Market, Temple and City Tour.

expect.title: Wet Season
expect.body: November - Feb are wet season in Bangkok. Prepare suitable attire for possible rains.

expect.title: Triple Room Bed
expect.body: Triple sharing room with 3 single beds will be provided based on availability. Extra bed will be added if no triple bed available on travel period.

expect.title: Meals
expect.body: Meals not provided during the trip (Lunch and Dinner). The driver will drop you off at a local Thai or Malay restaurant. The cost of the meals will be at your own expense. Breakfast is included and will be served as a buffet at the hotel.

expect.title: Market
expect.body: Ramkhamhaeng: open daily. Pratunam: open daily. Chatuchak: weekend only.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room (Additional RM450/person for Single Supplement).
Price is not applicable during peak seasons; please refer to the peak season surcharge.
Late Booking Surcharge of RM50/booking will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
This package is valid until 31st March 2027 travel period.
Private Transportation & Tour Guide is based on 12 hours basis. Additional fees will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be made in cash.
Quotation, consequence of itinerary and price are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements will be confirmed at least 15 days before trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting domestic flights.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment
